claim.claim-text: 1. A method of making a spray device (112, 202) for the delivery of drugs, the method comprising:
2. The method of a spray device (112, 202) for the delivery of drugs of claim 1, wherein the first nozzle plate layer (400) has a thickness ranging from 5 to 30 microns.
3. The method of making a spray device (112, 202) for the delivery of drugs of claim 1, wherein the second nozzle plate layer (424) has a thickness ranging from 5 to 30 microns.
4. The method of making a spray device (112, 202) for the delivery of drugs of claim 1, wherein the first nozzle plate layer (400) is laminated to the fluid flow layer (402).
5. The method of making a spray device (112, 202) for the delivery of drugs of claim 1, wherein the second nozzle plate layer (424) is laminated to the first nozzle plate layer (400).

6. The method of making a spray device (112, 202) for the delivery of drugs of claim 1, wherein the fluid ejection nozzles (422) having the first axial flow path length are adjacent to fluid ejection nozzles (432) having the second axial flow path length.
